name: IL-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Ford's large fundraising advantage over Koppie
Prediction markets price Democratic win near certainty
Open seat after Danny Davis's retirement
model.rationale: This Chicago-area seat is overwhelmingly Democratic, and La Shawn Ford has raised far more than Republican Chad Koppie, who reports almost no cash on hand. Markets price a Democratic win at near certainty, so the forecast stays firmly in Safe D territory.
model.watch: A surprise independent or third-party candidacy, or an unexpectedly competitive Democratic primary aftermath, could tighten the race slightly.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Danny Davis (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Danny Davis's retirement leaves this heavily Democratic Chicago district open, but the seat's fundamentals remain firmly blue. The district leans Democratic by roughly 34 points, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. La Shawn Ford has raised over $700,000 and holds more than $100,000 on hand, while Republican Chad Koppie has raised about $55,000 with essentially no cash remaining. Outside spending has also flowed against the Republican nominee.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at near certainty, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no general-election polling available, the forecast rests on the partisan lean, the money gap, and market pricing, all pointing to a comfortable Democratic hold in this open seat.
